# emoji-picker-element

The Labels page's emoji picker, copied here so the app needs no CDN or build step.

- `index.js`, `picker.js`, `database.js`, `LICENSE`: emoji-picker-element 1.29.1 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/nolanlawson/emoji-picker-element
- `data.json`: `en/emojibase/data.json` from emoji-picker-element-data 1.8.0 (Apache-2.0; emoji data from Emojibase, MIT)

To update: `npm install` both packages in a scratch folder and copy the same files over.
